sentences.text: Application praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith the High Court be pleased to condone the delay of 143 days in filing the above appeal before this Hon'ble Court in the interest of justice.

This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and the affidavit filed in support thereof, and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.CIBI THOMAS, SWARNA THOMAS & ANUSREE K., Advocates for the applicants and Standing counsel (B/O)for R3, the Court passed the following:
 P.T.O  C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, J  -----------------------------------------------
 C.M.Appl. No.1 of 2025  in  MACA.No.231 of 2025  ------------------------------------------------
Shobhana.K vs Muhammadali on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173839441/
1  Dated this the 07th day of February, 2025  ORDER
This is an application filed by the appellants praying for condoning the delay of 143 days in filing the appeal.
2. The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.
3. The petitioners filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of death of the victim in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 143 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
4. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioners will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.
The learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the 3rd respondent.
Policy is admitted, hence notice to respondents 1 and 2 is dispensed with.
The learned counsel for the appellant is directed to serve a copy of the appeal memorandum to the learned Standing Counsel.

SD/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE SMA 07-02-2025 /True Copy/

Assistant Registrar Shobhana.K vs Muhammadali on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173839441/
